scope: 25 exact historical keys outside other assignments; operators and endpoint scopes inspected. Full source page 217 re-read to resolve Austrian acceleration, British breakdown and unresolved imperial compensation.

rows.review_disposition: DFDC can internalize occupation preceding reconquest. Page 203 supports the initial crisis; preserve separately sourced recapture and Bonaparte’s role on 206/254 rather than assigning the full sequence to 203.
7EDE must retain Campo Formio leaving imperial compensation unresolved because Austrian recognition could not bind the Empire. Full 217 directly supports the distinction and later Rastadt congress.

032D can internalize the democratic constitution as an immediate step toward Babeuf’s deeper property programme. Preserve wider appeal of the first demand and do not equate every supporter with communism.
CB77 can internalize collective rotating executive and strict legislative incompatibility as separate constitutional checks. Preserve selection through both Councils and annual retirement.

5193 must retain failed war-rate/forced-loan measures and the state’s two-sided problem of paying and receiving depreciated paper. F6ED is the later replacement, not the immediate object of the 1795 response.

Preserve the same failed emergency fiscal response within 5193, with usable-revenue failure and recirculation of discounted paper. Do not transfer the whole episode to mandates merely because both currencies failed.

C83 must retain the electoral result disrupting the stable majority; 0364 supplies the resulting executive-legislative split. Retire an unresolved crisis label only with that actual consequence explicit.

Reject the mistaken land-bank-versus-Jacobin-press alternative. The bank was a proposed monetary remedy opposed partly through anti-financier politics, not an alternative form of political journalism.
3F2B can internalize Manège as a visible institution of the 1799 revival, with deputies/veterans and later closure. Preserve its distinction from Pantheon and constitutional circles.

FF3E must retain repudiation reducing obligations and enabling later fiscal reconstruction, alongside creditor loss and broken public faith. The abstract reconstruction node may retire; the enabling argument may not.

888503/C455 can retain Jalès within southern Catholic royalism. AC7C preserves a specific Nîmes-to-Jalès causal sequence, not exact equivalence to every regional membership relation; retain the broader category in parent content.

B888 must preserve Orléanism and Louis-Philippe as a distinct dynastic strategy within a heterogeneous royalist field. Do not equate all constitutional monarchists with that option; 0364 receives only the relevant parliamentary accommodation facet.

48B/0D88 must retain Bonaparte’s army addresses and dispatch of Augereau as material indirect participation. Retire the abstract army-partisanship target without making Fructidor solely an executive action in Paris.

Correct the target: domestic advantage from Bonaparte’s absence motivated approval of Egypt. Preserve this in DA4B/0D88 on 332, not as a motive for the whole structure of army dependence or evidence the Directors expected only failure.

Full 217 supports Fructidor hardening demands and inducing Austria to stop prolonging negotiations. Preserve this causal contribution in 7EDE and the comparative peace route; the same change broke British talks, so the two outcomes must remain distinct.

Reject failed_successor_to speculation: mandates facilitated land speculation before demonetization. F6ED/4E189 must retain enrichment and resentment; 59C’s general depreciation/hunger relation alone is not exact retention of the land-purchase mechanism.
4D74 preserves émigrés seeking and depending on foreign aid, with C479’s conditional strategic interests. Do not automatically assign the whole relation to every later expedition or surviving force.

CB77 can internalize Boissy’s rejection of the unused 1793 constitution as an attributed ideological premise. Retire the unbound Jacobin-democracy label without endorsing his judgment as a neutral account of all democratic politics.

3ABA/621 must retain Mirabeau advising Louis XVI, with limited influence and earlier withdrawal proposals distinct from Varennes. 69A’s contrast is related but not identical to advice; Louis XVIII is an inappropriate projection for this claim.

E268 can internalize intervention exposing divergent Irish, rural and French aims, with Wolfe Tone’s role and changing French commitment. Preserve late, inadequate aid and conditional expectations, not a shared liberation programme.

Preserve the 1796 mission’s timing and French delay while preparing the Irish expedition across 2E013/E268. A generic precedes edge can retire if the actual strategic connection is explicit; later Lille is a separate phase.

4E189 must retain distress making egalitarian criticism persuasive, while 032D preserves the particular programme. Do not claim material resentment created Babeuf’s entire doctrine or that all sufferers adopted it.
032D must retain coercive and punitive aims within the printed/leadership programme. Preserve differences among participants and do not sanitize the conspiracy into peaceful parliamentary reform.

Retire the chapter-conclusion synthesis edge as an organizational relation, retaining historical definition in 9EDD and the actual multi-causal defeat argument in 069F. Document placement adds no separate historical dependency.

B888 can internalize Institutes and the well-funded press as interacting electoral organization. Preserve mainstream electioneering separately from violent agents and avoid treating every press reader as a restoration partisan.
